limitation: Experimental cell detector and Bethesda-class labeller trained on APCData: human cervical Pap smear fields (CC BY 4.0), not veterinary data. Held-out test (61 images): cell-finding AP50 0.675; per-class AP50 NILM 0.83 (n=294), ASC-US 0.07 (n=59), ASC-H 0.13 (n=33), LSIL 0.25 (n=81), HSIL 0.03 (n=8), SCC 0.00 (n=7). Labels for abnormal classes are unreliable and rare classes (HSIL, SCC) have too few test boxes for a meaningful score. Splits are grouped by smear id parsed from file names; patient independence is unverified. Scores are uncalibrated. Stain, scale and preparation differences will reduce performance. Suggestions require qualified human review and are never diagnoses.
